figures.name: Ammon

ability.name: Ram's Oracle
ability.description: Reveal all enemy plans for 2 turns; grant one ally +3 to all stats.

figures.description: Great ram-headed sun god of the Berbers who became the oracle of Siwa consulted by Alexander the Great.

figures.name: Gurzil

ability.name: Bull Charge
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to one target; all warrior allies gain +2 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: Bull-headed war and sun god of the Berbers whose standard was carried into battle against the Byzantine armies.

figures.name: Tanit

ability.name: Moon Blessing
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; female and moon allies gain +3 magic.

figures.description: Supreme goddess of the Carthaginian Berbers who received the devotion of an entire civilization.

figures.name: Baal Hammon

ability.name: Sacred Fire
ability.description: Deal 5 fire damage to all enemies; 30% chance to ignite each one for 1 turn.

figures.description: Adopted Semitic sky and storm god who became the chief male deity of Carthage alongside Tanit.

figures.name: Antaeus

ability.name: Earthbound Power
ability.description: As long as this card touches earth, gain +3 defense and regenerate 2 HP per turn.

figures.description: Giant son of Poseidon and Gaia who drew strength from the earth and was unbeatable until lifted off it.

figures.name: Massinissa

ability.name: Kingdom's Will
ability.description: All Berber allies gain +2 to all stats; grant one ally a mounted combat bonus.

figures.description: First king of united Numidia whose divine ancestry and brilliance made him a near-mythological ancestor.

figures.name: Kahina

ability.name: Prophetess Sight
ability.description: Predict and negate the most powerful enemy ability each turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: Legendary Berber warrior queen and prophetess who led resistance against the Arab conquest of North Africa.

figures.name: Jugurtha

ability.name: Desert Guerrilla
ability.description: Move to any position; deal 4 damage from ambush position.

figures.description: Cunning Numidian king who outfought Rome for years using the desert itself as his weapon.

figures.name: Azurki

ability.name: Atlas Snowfall
ability.description: All enemies are chilled: -2 speed for 1 turn; allies with mountain affinity gain +2 defense.

figures.description: Snow goddess of the Atlas Mountains whose purity and cold protect the high peaks.

figures.name: Anzar

ability.name: Rain Calling
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all earth and nature allies; remove drought effects.

figures.description: Rain god invoked by Berber women in drought through ritual dances to bring the life-giving rains.

figures.name: Ifri

ability.name: Cave Mother
ability.description: When this card is in play, all summoned allies gain +1 defense on entry.

figures.description: Earth mother cave goddess whose name may have given Africa its name, mother of the Berber peoples.

figures.name: Atlas

ability.name: Eternal Burden
ability.description: This card can absorb unlimited damage for one ally per turn, but loses 1 power each time.

figures.description: The Titan condemned to bear the heavens on his shoulders for eternity at the edge of the world.

figures.name: Tin Hinan

ability.name: Founding Tent
ability.description: All Tuareg/Berber allies gain +1 to all stats upon entering.

figures.description: Semi-legendary fourth-century queen mother and founding ancestor of the Tuareg people.

figures.name: Amma (Berber)

ability.name: Home Ward
ability.description: Prevent one debuff from affecting any ally this turn.

figures.description: Small protective household spirit who guards the Berber home from illness and misfortune.

figures.name: Imazighen Spirit

ability.name: Free People
ability.description: This card cannot be charmed or controlled by any enemy ability.

figures.description: The ancestral spirit of the Amazigh people — the Free People — who can never truly be enslaved.

figures.name: Desert Jinn

ability.name: Desert Mirage
ability.description: Create a duplicate of this card: the duplicate vanishes after 1 turn dealing 2 damage.

figures.description: Shape-shifting desert spirit of the Sahara who takes the form of sandstorms and leads travelers astray.

figures.name: Syphax

ability.name: Numidian Horse
ability.description: All speed-based attacks this turn cannot be evaded by the enemy.

figures.description: Numidian king and ancestor hero whose cavalry were the finest light horse riders in the ancient world.

figures.name: Agelid

ability.name: Sacred Kingship
ability.description: While in play, allies cannot be debuffed by status effects below 5 intensity.

figures.description: The sacred Berber king whose authority derived from divine connection to land, ancestors and sky.

figures.name: Ifriqiya Lion

ability.name: Lion's Roar
ability.description: Frighten one enemy: they skip their next turn from the sacred lion's roar.

figures.description: The great Atlas lion, sacred to the Berbers and once guardian of the North African mountains.

figures.name: Neith of the West

ability.name: Loom of War
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 power and +3 defense from the weaving of battle fate.

figures.description: Ancient Libyan-Berber war and weaving goddess who became one of Egypt's oldest deities.
